name: duel_ninja
_prefilter_note: the roundhouse peaks over ~6 source frames; the default 7-frame landmark prefilter cost 5 deg of shin angle there (0.04 m of foot height). 5 costs 1.4 deg.
_root_scale_note: one stage, one scale: the initial separation and both travel distances must share a factor or the geometry does not close. 0.9715 is the mean of the two characters' leg/performer ratios (YBot 1.0102, Ninja 0.9328).
_stage_note: the defender (white shirt, screen-right). Same stage separation as duel_ybot, opposite side.

plant.comment: the defender never leaves the ground: both ankles stay between 0.05 and 0.14 m for the whole take. The fold over the body shot (pelvis 0.84 -> 0.75 @ src123) and the duck under the kick (pelvis 0.85 -> 0.46 @ src149) are pure knee bend, which a both-feet plant resolves by hip-height search.

_rest_blend_note: was 195/209: the arms reached full T-pose span ~4 source frames ahead of the performer (wrist span +0.121 m at src200).

arm_follow.comment: the guard measured 0.063-0.070 m narrower than the performer's for the whole fight. Not proportion - this character's shoulders are 0.008 m WIDER than the performer's scaled - it is the direction-preserving retarget landing on an unusual arm ratio (upper 0.210 / fore 0.308). arm_follow places the wrists at the performer's own shoulder-relative geometry and re-solves the chain at exact bone lengths.
